addSources.summary: Federal court case page for Jackson-Edney v. Labrador. Records the June 16, 2026 preliminary injunction and provisional class-action status blocking most of HB 752, the July 16, 2026 state appeal with the injunction remaining in place, and the felony escalation for repeat offences.

appendSummaryFacts: On June 16, 2026, a federal judge granted a preliminary injunction and provisional class-action status in Jackson-Edney v. Labrador. The injunction blocks the restroom portion of HB 752: a trans person may use public restrooms consistent with gender identity, except a multi-user restroom may still be enforced against when a single-user restroom is available on the same floor. The changing-room portion is not blocked.
The State of Idaho filed a notice of appeal on July 16, 2026; the injunction remains in place pending appeal.
HB 752 penalties escalate: first offence a misdemeanour (up to one year), second offence a felony (up to five years).

addSources.summary: Court case page for Doe v. State of Kansas. Records the March 10, 2026 denial of a temporary restraining order, the April 6, 2026 amended petition adding plaintiffs, and the September 29, 2026 evidentiary hearing on the preliminary-injunction motion.

appendSummaryFacts: The Douglas County district court denied a temporary restraining order on March 10, 2026.
On April 6, 2026, plaintiffs filed an amended petition adding four plaintiffs (six total).
An evidentiary hearing on the motion for a preliminary injunction blocking enforcement of SB 244 was scheduled to begin September 29, 2026.
